package rulefixtures

import (
	gin "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
	binding "github.com/gin-gonic/gin/binding"
)

// scenario for multiple_shouldbind_calls_same_handler: Gin handlers that bind the request body multiple times in one function.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: gin; severity: contextual.
type LoginRequest struct {
	Username string `json:"username"`
	Password string `json:"password"`
}

type ProfileRequest struct {
	Token string `json:"token"`
}

func scenario328Positive(ctx *gin.Context) {
	var login LoginRequest
	if err := ctx.ShouldBindBodyWith(&login, binding.JSON); err != nil {
		ctx.JSON(400, gin.H{"error": err.Error()})
		return
	}
	var profile ProfileRequest
	if err := ctx.ShouldBindBodyWith(&profile, binding.JSON); err != nil {
		ctx.JSON(400, gin.H{"error": err.Error()})
		return
	}
	ctx.JSON(200, gin.H{"user": login.Username, "token": profile.Token})
}
